This installation stretches a painted canvas between two facades of the courtyard, so the work reads differently from every approach. The artist treats the gap between the buildings as a frame, and the fabric as a moving surface that the weather keeps rewriting. Visitors are invited to walk the full length of the passage before looking up, which is when the composition resolves into a single figure.
